title: Concept: Form submits to a plaintext HTTP action on an HTTPS page
description: A secure page posts a form to a plaintext endpoint. Browsers no longer block form submission as active mixed content, so the request leaves the browser over HTTP and is readable and modifiable by any network observer. The failure usually appears when a checkout or login endpoint is configured per environment and the scheme is left behind.
risk: Form fields readable and modifiable in transit; MEDIUM severity.
